change.what_changed: Initial publication. New subcategory created after adversarial audit found octopus/squid/cuttlefish fell between the fish and shellfish subcategories. Government-limit standard (Method v2.0), as-consumed: inorganic arsenic 50 (EU 2025/1891 — the strictest iAs in all of seafood), methylmercury by disclosed read-across from the non-predatory fishery value.
